title: Woodys power building
author: Cory W.
desc: Building strength and some muscle after you complete the program you can do a deload followed by resting the program with the weights you was using on the last week. And the best part is that literally anyone can take advantage of a program like this because you can start at any level

ex.note: Start with 80% of 1 rep max for 5 reps increase weight by 5lb for each following set if you started with 250lb for 5 reps you should end with 270 for 1 rep following week increase weight to 255 for first set ending at 275 and do this every week
Where using this as building work start with a lighter weight maintain same weight through all working sets and add weight every week 5lb
You can alternate between regular inclined and declined however you want

This is same principle as the others in the program start with a weight that you can move for 5 sets of 5 reps and add 5lb every week until you can’t add weight use same weight for a week or 2 until you can add more

Start with a weight that you can comfortably move for the sets and reps focused on form. The weight will stay the same for all sets and reps every week you will add 5lb untill you can’t and then maintain the weight for a week or two untill you can add more
Same as the RDL maintain same weight for all working sets adding 5lb every week start with a weight you can move for all sets and reps
Same as RDL and the extensions
Same as every thing els

Weight you can comfortably move for all sets and reps weight will be kept the same for all sets and add 5lb per week if you can when you hit a wall keep the weight the same and add when you can this is a harder one to keep moving
Same as above

Start with body weight if you have to and keep adding weight as you can if you have to start with body weight add 5lb per week if you can start with weight same thing add 5lb per week if you can’t do dips yet that’s fine if you can only do 1 do 5 sets of 1. If you can’t do 1 do negative dips jump to lockout and let yourself down slowly
Start with a weight you can comfortably move for all sets and reps add weight every week
Same as above

Start with a weight that you can move for all sets and reps add 5lb every week and you can do different variations I personally stand completely bent over at 90 degrees and let the weight down to the ground and pull straight up like that if you do it this way keep your core and back tight
